newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RONALDO AND SUKER HAT-TRICKS KEEP REAL AND BARCA CLEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO AND SUKER HAT-TRICKS KEEP REAL AND BARCA CLEAR.

text.p: Barcelona striker Ronaldo and Real Madrid's Davor Suker each scored hat-tricks on Sunday as the top two in the Spanish league moved away from the pack in convincing fashion.
Real stayed six points ahead of their arch-rivals after beating Oviedo 6-1, while Barcelona gave beleaguered coach Bobby Robson some breathing space with a 4-1 win over Zaragoza.
A further six points back in third place are Real Betis, who were due to play fifth-placed Real Sociedad later on Sunday.
Champions Atletico Madrid moved up provisionally to fourth place by beating Hercules 2-0 on Saturday, while Real Sociedad went down unexpectedly 3-0 at Valladolid and stayed sixth.
On a day of numerous red cards and penalties, Athletic Bilbao came back from 2-0 down to salvage a draw with Racing Santander despite being reduced to nine men.
Sevilla, however, could not overcome the same numerical shortage and slipped further into trouble by going down 4-1 to fellow strugglers Logrones.
